analysis.cassette_pooling: refused when included ledgers carry different cassette digests
analysis.direction_labels: consistent when the delta interval lies wholly on the expected side, inconsistent when wholly on the other side, else inconclusive; a=b is consistent when the interval contains 0
analysis.estimator: mean over Instances (tasks x seeds) per arm and group
excluded: attempt not run under a complete registration
analysis.quantile: linear interpolation between order statistics (Hyndman-Fan type 7)
analysis.rng: random.Random(derived_seed).random(); index floor(u*n); derived_seed = first 16 hex of sha256('<seed>|<hypothesis>|<arm>|<group>|<metric>')
analysis.undefined_values: excluded from that metric's sample and counted as undefined

H1.claim: A world whose rules are fixed for the life of the Build yields higher task success and fewer repeated failures than an otherwise identical world whose rules drift mid-task without notice.

harness_recorded_tokens.label: harness-recorded at the model boundary; not a ledger quantity

H2.claim: One script per turn completes tasks in fewer turns than one primitive per turn, without a higher partial-failure cost.

harness_recorded_tokens.label: harness-recorded at the model boundary; not a ledger quantity

H3.claim: The advantages measured in H1 and H2 grow with task length, and a stable world lets the model reuse a rule learned earlier without re-probing.

harness_recorded_tokens.label: harness-recorded at the model boundary; not a ledger quantity

H4.claim: After a versioned recompilation with a changelog the model adopts the changed rule in fewer turns and with fewer old-rule errors than after a silent change, and the changelog carries more of the effect than the version signal alone.

harness_recorded_tokens.label: harness-recorded at the model boundary; not a ledger quantity

turns_to_success.method: state per turn replayed from the ledger through the kernel; the predicate is evaluated after each turn and the first true turn is the value
